blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Fraser Heights rose from 13 in June to 19 in September (+46.2%), and 6 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 1.2% of Surrey’s 1,523 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Fraser Heights?
Fraser Heights also had 88 houses listed and 9 sold in September, against 19 condos and townhomes listed. The Fraser Heights houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Fraser Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

23 townhomes sold in Fraser Heights with a median price of $925,000 (the middle half sold between $899,900 and $1,029,500), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 100.0% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $553 per square foot, a median year built of 2025 and a median strata fee of $324 a month. 3 condos sold in Fraser Heights, too few (5 needed) to give a typical price.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Fraser Heights?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 19 condos and townhomes listed in Fraser Heights. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Fraser Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Fraser Heights had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Fraser Heights from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 6 condos and townhomes sold in Fraser Heights over those 4 months, out of 591 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Fraser Heights sell for?
faq.a: 23 townhomes sold in Fraser Heights between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $925,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Fraser Heights?
faq.a: The median was 18 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 100.0% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
